$comment: Single source of truth for msg's Power BI brand standards. SKILL.md references these keys instead of restating literal values — edit here, not in prose. If you change a color/font/size, regenerate msg-theme-executive.json and msg-theme-operational.json to match (see references/contract.md for the exact field mapping).

primary.name: MSG Red
primary.usage: Important KPI, primary brand accent, `bad` semantic slot

secondaryDecorative.name: MSG Petrol Light
secondaryDecorative.usage: Large decorative fills/backgrounds ONLY. Never text, data labels, axis labels, KPI indicators, or a good:/bad: theme color.

secondaryAccessible.name: MSG Petrol Dark
secondaryAccessible.usage: Any text, data label, or chart series carrying a measure value. Supporting KPI. `good` semantic slot.

neutral.name: MSG Gray
neutral.usage: Neutral information, `neutral` semantic slot, categories past the top-6 rank
